name: Dải giấy trắng dài
description: one long line; giữ đúng tỷ lệ ảnh, đặt chữ trong vùng safe đã đăng ký.

origin.prompt: Create ONE reusable physical paper text backplate for a contemporary vibrant Pop Collage video. The attached image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, especially its pasted white text strips and vivid colors. Output only the blank paper piece, no lettering, no text, no symbols, no other objects. Orthographic overhead scan, flat orientation, real paper fibers and slightly uneven torn edges, clean fresh editorial material, not antique or grunge. Fully transparent outside the piece. No cast shadow (added in compositor); subtle thickness along edge is fine. Broad uniformly lit interior reserved for later native text. Piece fills image with a small transparent margin. A long narrow white paper strip, aspect ratio roughly 6:1. Mostly straight long edges with delicate fibers, irregular torn short ends. Clean white interior, negligible creasing. Used under a single line of dark text.

rights.note: Giấy tạo bằng imagegen trong dự án; prompt và tham chiếu gốc được giữ lại.
